description.value:
Your nails have set hard and faceted, glasslands-glass.

Gift — +1 circumstance to Crafting checks to work stone or glass; they double as an improvised piercing tool. Tithe — They chip instead of bending: any bare-handed check that fails by 5 or more leaves you clumsy 1 until you file them smooth (10 minutes).

cinderfall.incomplete: "Any bare-handed check that fails by 5 or more leaves you clumsy 1 until filed smooth" has no rule-element equivalent: no generic actor-level hook exists for 'inflict a condition on yourself when any check, of any kind, fails by 5+' -- pf2e's degree-of-failure consequences are always authored per-action (a spell's own critical-failure branch, an item's own effect), never as a standing actor-wide rule reacting to arbitrary checks.
